Definition: from a presumed compound of G5550 and the base of G5147; to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger):--spend time.
BiblicalUsage: Paul hastens to be at Jerusalem for Pentecost if possible, and the word is the wearing away of time by delay. He will not spend time in Asia, because the days will not wait for him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul shows us urgency without panic: the days are short, and the work is great, so he spends them on purpose.
